# Coed Lax ATX

> Coed pickup lacrosse in Austin, TX. No team, no tryouts — just drop in and play.

Coed Lax ATX organizes casual, drop-in pickup lacrosse games in Austin, Texas.
Games are open to all skill levels, coed, and pay-to-play per session — there
is no season-long team or membership commitment.

## Key facts

- Location: Austin, TX
- Format: pickup / drop-in, not a league or team
- Skill level: all levels welcome
- Cost: pay-per-session, no membership fee

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://coedlaxatx.org/): overview of the group and how to join a game
- [FAQ](https://coedlaxatx.org/faq): common questions about cost, skill level, gear, and schedule
